children: Overview
Canada graphene maker's fiscal Q4 revenue grew 7% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q4 declined compared to last year
Company expects fiscal 2027 revenue growth of 11-20% with new product launches
Outlook
NanoXplore sees fiscal 2027 revenue between C$130 mln and C$140 mln
Company expects fiscal 2028 revenue between C$160 mln and C$170 mln
NanoXplore anticipates positive free cash flow in fiscal 2027
Result Drivers
HIGHER SALES VOLUMES - Q4 revenue growth was mainly due to increased sales volumes, partly offset by lower tooling revenues
OPERATING COST ADJUSTMENTS - Co said it mitigated volume drop by adjusting operating cost structure
MATERIAL PRICE INCREASES - Management cited material price increases as a factor impacting results
